# Verdant Resonance

<!-- Generated by Prism from prism/spec.json. Change the app through your agent with /prism, not by editing this file. -->

Decides the botanical soundscape, diurnal harmony, humane restorative pacing, and flora resonance response as a player explores a peaceful procedural garden without violence or conflict.

## Request

A request is one line of 7 fields separated by single spaces, in this order. Anything else is answered `invalid`.

| Field | Kind | Accepts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `biome` | choice | `meadow`, `grove`, `crystal`, `wetland`, `sanctuary` |
| `plant` | choice | `chime-lily`, `pulse-fern`, `echo-lotus`, `drone-moss`, `star-orchid` |
| `action` | choice | `observe`, `touch`, `attune`, `stroll`, `stillness` |
| `atmosphere` | choice | `dawn`, `golden`, `twilight`, `starlight` |
| `chorus` | choice | `dormant`, `awakened` |
| `proximity` | number | whole number from 0 up to 100 |
| `velocity` | number | whole number from 0 up to 30 |

The answer is one of `sanctuary-chorus`, `serene-rest`, `nocturnal-symphony`, `dawn-arpeggio`, `harmonic-bloom`, `crystalline-choir`, `melodic-chime`, `rhythmic-pulse`, `ambient-drone`, `wind-whisper`, or `invalid`.

## Rules

The first rule that matches decides.

- **REQ-001** When action is stillness and velocity equals 0 and biome is sanctuary and proximity is at most 45, the answer is `serene-rest`. (`rule1`)
- **REQ-002** When biome is sanctuary and chorus is awakened and action is attune and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `sanctuary-chorus`. (`rule2`)
- **REQ-003** When chorus is awakened and plant is star-orchid and atmosphere is starlight and action is observe and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `sanctuary-chorus`. (`rule3`)
- **REQ-004** When chorus is awakened and biome is wetland and plant is echo-lotus and action is attune and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `sanctuary-chorus`. (`rule4`)
- **REQ-005** When action is attune and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `harmonic-bloom`. (`rule5`)
- **REQ-006** When chorus is awakened and biome is meadow and plant is chime-lily and action is touch and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `harmonic-bloom`. (`rule6`)
- **REQ-007** When atmosphere is starlight and action is stillness and velocity equals 0 and proximity is at most 30, the answer is `nocturnal-symphony`. (`rule7`)
- **REQ-008** When atmosphere is twilight and plant is echo-lotus and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `nocturnal-symphony`. (`rule8`)
- **REQ-009** When atmosphere is starlight and plant is drone-moss and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `nocturnal-symphony`. (`rule9`)
- **REQ-010** When atmosphere is dawn and plant is chime-lily and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `dawn-arpeggio`. (`rule10`)
- **REQ-011** When atmosphere is golden and biome is meadow and action is touch and proximity is at most 20, the answer is `dawn-arpeggio`. (`rule11`)
- **REQ-012** When atmosphere is dawn and biome is grove and plant is pulse-fern and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `dawn-arpeggio`. (`rule12`)
- **REQ-013** When biome is crystal and action is touch and proximity is at most 20, the answer is `crystalline-choir`. (`rule13`)
- **REQ-014** When plant is star-orchid and biome is sanctuary and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `crystalline-choir`. (`rule14`)
- **REQ-015** When plant is chime-lily and proximity is at most 30 and velocity is at most 20, the answer is `melodic-chime`. (`rule15`)
- **REQ-016** When plant is star-orchid and action is touch and proximity is at most 30, the answer is `melodic-chime`. (`rule16`)
- **REQ-017** When plant is pulse-fern and proximity is at most 30 and velocity is at least 10 and velocity is at most 20, the answer is `rhythmic-pulse`. (`rule17`)
- **REQ-018** When plant is echo-lotus and biome is wetland and proximity is at most 30, the answer is `rhythmic-pulse`. (`rule18`)
- **REQ-019** When plant is drone-moss and proximity is at most 30 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `ambient-drone`. (`rule19`)
- **REQ-020** When biome is grove and plant is echo-lotus and action is touch and proximity is at most 30, the answer is `melodic-chime`. (`rule20`)
- **REQ-021** When biome is crystal and plant is pulse-fern and action is stroll and proximity is at most 30 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `rhythmic-pulse`. (`rule21`)
- **REQ-022** When atmosphere is golden and plant is drone-moss and action is stillness and velocity equals 0 and proximity is at most 45, the answer is `serene-rest`. (`rule22`)
- **REQ-023** When chorus is awakened and plant is pulse-fern and action is touch and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10, the answer is `harmonic-bloom`. (`rule23`)
- **REQ-024** When velocity is at most 10 and proximity is at most 45, the answer is `ambient-drone`. (`rule24`)
- **Otherwise** the answer is `wind-whisper`.

## Properties

- **INV-001** It always answers `serene-rest` when action is stillness and velocity equals 0 and biome is sanctuary and proximity is at most 45. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv001Holds`)
- **INV-002** It always answers `sanctuary-chorus` when biome is sanctuary and chorus is awakened and action is attune and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv002Holds`)
- **INV-003** It always answers `sanctuary-chorus` when chorus is awakened and biome is wetland and plant is echo-lotus and action is attune and proximity is at most 20 and velocity is at most 10. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv003Holds`)
- **INV-004** It never answers `sanctuary-chorus` when proximity is above 45. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv004Holds`)
- **INV-005** It never answers `harmonic-bloom` when proximity is above 45. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv005Holds`)
- **INV-006** It never answers `nocturnal-symphony` when proximity is above 45. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv006Holds`)
- **INV-007** It never answers `crystalline-choir` when proximity is above 45. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv007Holds`)
- **INV-008** It always answers `wind-whisper` when proximity is above 45. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv008Holds`)
- **INV-009** It never answers `serene-rest` when velocity is above 20. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv009Holds`)
- **INV-010** It never answers `sanctuary-chorus` when velocity is above 20. proved by Lean. (theorem `inv010Holds`)

## What is proved and what is tested

Lean proves each property marked proved above, for every request that decodes, with no exceptions and no sampling. The proof is about `judge`, the function the WebAssembly guest runs, because both come from the same model.

The parsing of requests is tested, not proved: the acceptance vectors in the app replay through the built guest, including malformed and oversized requests.

Nothing here says the rules are the right rules. That is the part only you can judge.
